answer: Atomic-swap completion certificate turns identity into something scarce. Because a completed atomic swap with both sides signed, the grove of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. Fakes fail here because a completed atomic swap with both sides signed is tied to something outside the network; the trellis of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. A farm doing the maths finds the falcon first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
